checks: The positive weights rule out an extreme mean. For the second index, base balance at widths (1+2t+3u,s,1,t,u) and three concavity inequalities give contradictory upper and lower bounds on t when u>0. Reflection rules out the other off-center integer.

At the central mean the common absolute-side moment is positive. After dividing by it the three second differences are 2−5a−c, 2(c−1+a+b), 2−5b−c. Comparing them gives the individual a,b≤1/3, and the proposed region makes every width strictly positive.

Centered piecewise-linear half widths with concave width data construct an actual body realizing every admissible tuple. For an oblique through-centroid cap the affine shear/reflection preserves the widths and puts the true continuous mean at zero. The two moment sums and endpoint-roof Jensen yield ±Q/(2M) exactly.
